purpose: Real VASP labels for bounded foundation-model adaptation; not an interface or nucleation dataset

selection.Al: Selected: single species, nonmagnetic pilot, connects to proposed Al alloy research
selection.Cu: Feasible alternative, less direct connection to current brief; no novelty claim
selection.Ni: Deferred: magnetic state and spin consistency complicate first reference protocol
selection.Al-Ti/TiB2: Deferred: segregation, terminations and interface size require a larger dedicated dataset

generator.calculator: ASE EMT for proposals only; never export EMT labels

split_policy.liquidlike_test: 6 frames from two independent proposal trajectories; not equilibrium DFT liquid
split_policy.leakage_limit: Common crystal prototypes may occur in OMat24; no pretraining-independent benchmark claim

reference_protocol.convergence_status: unvalidated; labeling blocked until calibration passes

acceptance.failure_policy: Stop and retain evidence; no automatic looser tolerance or reference escalation

label_contract.energy: VASP force-consistent free energy TOTEN, eV per configuration
label_contract.energy_sigma0: record separately, never pair with finite-smearing forces for fitting
label_contract.stress: tensile-positive eV/Angstrom^3; Voigt xx yy zz yz xz xy
label_contract.reference_alignment: Do not mix OMat24 PAW54 labels with local PAW64 labels. Fit any elemental energy shift on train only; report raw and shifted validation/test metrics.

allocation_plan.authorization: pending user response; preparation does not authorize submission
